description: This file defines the GeoZone entity class, which is a part of the core business model related to geographical zones within the application. It utilizes JPA annotations for ORM mapping and includes relationships to descriptions and countries.

classes.name: GeoZone
classes.description: An entity representing a geographical zone, including relationships to descriptions and associated countries, with ORM mappings and basic properties.

methods.name: GeoZone()
methods.description: Default constructor for the GeoZone entity.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the GeoZone.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier of the GeoZone.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the GeoZone.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the GeoZone.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Retrieves the code of the GeoZone.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code of the GeoZone.

methods.name: getCountries
methods.description: Returns the list of countries associated with this GeoZone.

methods.name: setCountries
methods.description: Sets the list of countries for this GeoZone.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the list of descriptions for this GeoZone.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the list of descriptions for this GeoZone.
